comment: Rules are checked top to bottom; the first match wins. Omitted matchers match anything. Edit freely: the server reloads this file within 2 seconds, and keeps the old policy if the new one is invalid (check with: relay policy check --policy policy.json). The transfer tool is checked as fs_read of every source file plus fs_write of every destination file.

rules.comment: Never touch secrets or git internals, even with approval.
rules.reason: secrets and git internals are off limits

rules.comment: Destructive-looking commands need a human. A seatbelt, not a wall: regexes are easy to get around.
Everyday commands on the Windows box, inside the work folder.
The mac agent may edit inside the work folder.
Anything else that writes or runs: ask.
